title: My Turkey got steamed !
text:
My Turkey got steamed !. I have a few electric nonstick roaster, that I love. Nesco is my favorite.

I thought with the convection oven (Fan!) I would get a crisp skin on a turkey or chicken, but all it did was "Steam" my turkey, and leave the skin White, and yucky looking, and feeling, but the Turkey did taste good.
If you do not care how your turkey looks, this would be fine. Although allot of paparika does wonders!
If you just have one oven,This does free up your oven for other foods to cook...
Also in the summer, I have pluged these types of roasters in outside, so the house does not get hot.
Not sure about this one, but I'm sure you can also bake a cake in there!

We do not eat the skin, but it was ugly to serve it, and some people like the skin. I bought two and got the same results.

Also The fan kept cuting into the leg! I had to keep rearanging the turkey. You can use this with out using the fan, but isn't that the idea!!!
Needless to say, I returned mine.

But this is good to use to make allot of soup, chilie, casseroles. Ribs are tender in this type of roaster, smothered in BBQ sause etc.

product_metadata.title: Nesco American Harvest 4842-14-30 Non-Stick 12-Quart Convection Roaster Oven, White
features: Holds up to a 12 pound turkey
Electric convection fan circulates hot air
description: The large capacity of this 12 Qt white convection roast-air oven holds up to a 12 pound turkey. The electric convection fan circulates hot air. The convenient high dome hinged cover makes cooking and serving easy. Its raised chrome plated roasting rack promotes even air flow and easy food removal. Removable non stick cookwell makes cleanup fast and simple. Adjustable temperature control ranges from 200 degrees to 450 degrees Fahrenheit.
